draft.title: Containment and the Truman Doctrine
card: the United States policy of stopping communism from spreading to new countries, rather than trying to remove it where it already ruled.
in 1947 President Truman promised American support for free peoples resisting pressure from armed groups or outside powers. Aid to Greece and Turkey was the first test.
from 1948 the United States gave billions of dollars to help rebuild Western Europe. It aimed to ease the poverty in which communism could gain support.
in 1949 the United States, Canada and several Western European states formed a military alliance. An attack on one member would be treated as an attack on all.
draft.remember: Containment used aid and alliances to stop communism spreading, not to remove it.

a.q: What was the main aim of the American policy of containment?
opts: To stop communism spreading to new countries
To end communism in the Soviet Union by force
To rebuild the Soviet economy after the war
To remove all American troops from Europe
a.why: Containment aimed to hold communism within its existing limits. Ending it in the Soviet Union by force is tempting but wrong, because containment did not try to remove it where it already ruled.
a.clue: Think of the word contain: to hold within limits.

b.q: A war-damaged Western European country has food shortages and growing support for communists. Which American step was meant to help in this case?
opts: The Marshall Plan, giving money to rebuild
NATO, a military alliance of member states
The Soviet plan to rebuild its own economy
b.why: The Marshall Plan gave money to rebuild economies and ease poverty, where communism could gain support. NATO is a tempting choice, but it was a military alliance, not economic aid.
b.clue: The problem is poverty, not an army.

a.best: To stop communism spreading to new countries

b.best: The Marshall Plan, giving money to rebuild

check.summary: No problems found. The dates and descriptions of the Truman Doctrine, Marshall Plan and NATO are accurate, and both questions have a single clear answer that the card supports.
